items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 9:1
items.html:
(To the question) Achoraim of AVI
They are the totality of the seven kings, which are the MAN and the records of the heads of the kings, as above, Item 8; see there. (p. 502, Item 25)
